record.title: The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy
record.titleEn: The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy
record.description: The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy is a story-heavy adventure and tactical RPG created by teams led by Kazutaka Kodaka and Kotaro Uchikoshi. Fifteen students are forced to defend the isolated Last Defense Academy from grotesque invaders for 100 days. Between tactical battles, players explore, spend free time with classmates, build relationships, craft gifts, and make choices that can lead to a very large number of story outcomes.

faq.q: Is The Hundred Line a tactical RPG?
faq.a: Yes. Tactical defensive battles are a major gameplay pillar, combined with adventure and visual-novel storytelling.

faq.q: Why is the game called The Hundred Line?
faq.a: The central premise tasks the students with defending the academy for 100 days.

faq.q: Does it have multiple endings?
faq.a: Yes. Branching choices and many routes are a major part of the game’s identity.

faq.q: Is it multiplayer?
faq.a: No. The Nintendo Switch release is a single-player game.

faq.q: What does the Digital Deluxe Edition include?
faq.a: Official store descriptions include the base game plus a Digital Art Book and Digital Soundtrack.

record.title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
record.titleEn: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
record.description: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild reimagines the Zelda formula as a vast open-air adventure. After awakening from a 100-year slumber, Link must recover his memories, survive the harsh wilderness, and challenge Calamity Ganon. The journey blends shrine puzzles, physics-driven experimentation, open exploration, cooking, weapon durability, and one of Nintendo's most acclaimed adventure worlds.

gameplayPillars.title: Open-air exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Climb, glide, ride, and experiment across a huge version of Hyrule where the world rarely forces a fixed order.

gameplayPillars.title: Physics-driven problem solving
gameplayPillars.description: Fire, metal, wind, explosives, and environmental interactions create emergent solutions in both puzzles and combat.

gameplayPillars.title: Shrines and Divine Beasts
gameplayPillars.description: More than one hundred shrines and four Divine Beasts provide puzzle-driven progression and memorable dungeon-style goals.

gameplayPillars.title: Survival systems and cooking
gameplayPillars.description: Weather, stamina, food, elixirs, and gear preparation matter constantly, especially in tougher climates and battles.

gameplayPillars.title: Weapon variety and improvisation
gameplayPillars.description: Weapons break over time, encouraging experimentation with swords, spears, bows, shields, runes, and environmental tricks.

record.worldSummary: Hyrule is presented as a giant interconnected wilderness full of towers, shrines, villages, stables, enemy camps, and hidden landmarks that reward curiosity from the first hour to the final battle.

storyChapters.title: Awaken on the Great Plateau
storyChapters.body: Link wakes after a century of sleep and begins learning the basics of survival and exploration while the mysterious voice of Zelda guides him.

storyChapters.title: Recover memories across Hyrule
storyChapters.body: As Link explores, he uncovers the past through recovered memories and learns what happened before Calamity Ganon consumed Hyrule.

storyChapters.title: Free the Divine Beasts
storyChapters.body: Link can aid the peoples of Hyrule and liberate the Divine Beasts from Ganon's control, weakening the final threat.

storyChapters.title: Prepare through shrines, gear, and allies
storyChapters.body: The adventure supports many play styles: players can hunt for stronger gear, solve shrines, cook buffs, tame horses, and master combat systems.

storyChapters.title: Face Calamity Ganon
storyChapters.body: Once ready, Link can storm Hyrule Castle and confront the source of the calamity in an ending shaped by the journey taken.

features: A landmark open-world Zelda adventure
Massive freedom in exploration and progression order
Shrine puzzle content and physics-based experimentation
Expansion Pass adds new story and challenge content
One of Nintendo's most acclaimed single-player adventures

faq.q: Does Breath of the Wild support Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists the original Nintendo Switch version as supported on Nintendo Switch 2, with behavior consistent with Nintendo Switch.

faq.q: What is included in the Expansion Pass?
faq.a: The Expansion Pass includes the Master Trials content and The Champion's Ballad story content, plus some bonus in-game treasure chests.

faq.q: Is the game multiplayer?
faq.a: No. Breath of the Wild is a single-player adventure with no competitive or cooperative gameplay modes.

faq.q: How open is the progression?
faq.a: Very open. After the opening area, players can choose where to explore, which shrines to tackle, and when to approach the main objective.

faq.q: Why is this game so highly regarded?
faq.a: Its sense of discovery, systemic design, environmental freedom, and cohesive open-world structure made it one of the most celebrated action-adventure games of its generation.

verdictPros: Outstanding open-world freedom
Systems-based exploration and combat feel fresh
Shrines and environmental puzzles are highly memorable
Expansion Pass meaningfully extends the adventure

verdictCons: Weapon durability remains divisive
Traditional Zelda dungeons are lighter than in some older entries
Performance is a 30 fps experience on the original Switch
Story is more environmental than cinematic
Inventory management can feel busy early on

record.title: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom
record.titleEn: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom
record.description: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom places Princess Zelda in the starring role for a new top-down adventure. Rather than focusing purely on sword combat, the game emphasizes Zelda's ability to create echoes of objects and creatures, allowing players to build bridges, summon helpers, solve puzzles, and approach combat indirectly. It carries forward a toy-like visual sensibility while giving the series a fresh protagonist perspective.
record.descriptionEn: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom places Princess Zelda in the starring role for a new top-down adventure. Rather than focusing purely on sword combat, the game emphasizes Zelda's ability to create echoes of objects and creatures, allowing players to build bridges, summon helpers, solve puzzles, and approach combat indirectly. It carries forward a toy-like visual sensibility while giving the series a fresh protagonist perspective.

faq.q: How does combat work?

record.titleEn: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening
record.description: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening is a full Nintendo Switch remake of the beloved portable classic. Stranded on mysterious Koholint Island, Link must explore dungeons, gather the Instruments of the Sirens, and unravel the island's dreamlike secrets. The remake updates the game with a toy-like visual style, modernized controls, quality-of-life improvements, and a dungeon-building side mode.

contents.label: Full Switch remake of the portable classic

gameplayPillars.title: Classic top-down Zelda structure
gameplayPillars.description: The game focuses on exploration, keys, tools, and dungeons in a style closer to traditional 2D Zelda adventures.

gameplayPillars.title: Koholint Island mystery
gameplayPillars.description: The island itself becomes part of the story, with strange characters and dreamlike narrative turns setting the tone apart from Hyrule-based entries.

gameplayPillars.title: Distinct remake presentation
gameplayPillars.description: The toy-like art direction gives the remake a memorable visual identity while keeping the original map structure recognizable.

gameplayPillars.title: Dungeon puzzle progression
gameplayPillars.description: Each dungeon emphasizes item usage, combat timing, and room-by-room problem solving.

gameplayPillars.title: Portable-friendly pacing
gameplayPillars.description: The game's structure works especially well in shorter play sessions, making it a strong handheld fit.

record.worldSummary: Koholint Island is compact but dense, full of hidden secrets, memorable NPCs, trading-sequence moments, caves, dungeons, and a dreamlike mood that makes the adventure stand out in the Zelda series.

storyChapters.title: Wash ashore on Koholint Island
storyChapters.body: After a storm, Link awakens on a mysterious island far from Hyrule and begins searching for a way home.

storyChapters.title: Gather the Instruments of the Sirens
storyChapters.body: The central quest sends Link across the island's varied regions and dungeons to collect the items needed to awaken the Wind Fish.

storyChapters.title: Meet the island's strange residents
storyChapters.body: The cast includes memorable characters whose humor and mystery help define the game's personality.

storyChapters.title: Complete dungeons and trading quests
storyChapters.body: Progress requires both dungeon mastery and side content, including item exchanges that open new paths.

storyChapters.title: Uncover the island's truth
storyChapters.body: The story builds toward one of the series' most memorable endings as the nature of Koholint is finally revealed.

features: Faithful remake of a beloved 2D Zelda game
Charming art direction and cleaner controls
Compact structure with strong dungeon design
Memorable story tone and emotional ending
Excellent fit for short or portable sessions

faq.q: Is Link's Awakening a remake?
faq.a: Yes. It is a full Nintendo Switch remake of the original Game Boy title.

faq.q: Is the game multiplayer?
faq.a: No. It is a single-player adventure.

faq.q: How long is the game?
faq.a: The main story is relatively compact compared with larger Zelda titles, but optional secrets and collectibles extend playtime.

faq.q: What style of Zelda is it?
faq.a: It is a top-down, classic Zelda structure built around dungeons, tools, key items, and map exploration.

faq.q: Why do players like it so much?
faq.a: Its compact design, memorable island setting, and emotional story twist make it one of the most beloved classic Zelda adventures.

verdictPros: Excellent remake presentation
Strong classic Zelda dungeon flow
Memorable island setting and ending
Portable-friendly pacing
Great entry point for 2D Zelda fans
verdictCons: Shorter than modern flagship Zelda releases
Performance dips are occasionally noticeable on original Switch
Limited replay value compared with huge open-world entries
Dungeon Builder is lighter than a full extra campaign
Less mechanical complexity than larger modern games
